item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00156","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C07","C14"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 provides a nearly verbatim, provision-by-provision template for the child: an identified official approaching compulsory retirement under the same Act, the same public-interest finding, the same statutory authority, and the same exemption mechanism. Only the official, office, dates, and duration were materially changed. C07 is also a strong template and shares the child's indefinite duration, but its first recital uses somewhat different retirement language. C14 shares the authority, indefinite exemption, and even the Civil Service Commission setting, but concerns a further exemption and therefore has a less parallel factual recital.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Frances Perkins ... will, during the month of April 1952 become subject to compulsory retirement for age under the provisions of the Civil Service Retirement Act of May 29, 1930, as amended, unless exempted therefrom by Executive order","parent_excerpt":"Hugh H.
